measures.name: _CF RI BG
measures.expression:
VAR ri = [MS Realization Index]
RETURN
SWITCH(TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(ri),        BLANK(),
    ri < 50,            "#FCEBEB",
    ri < 80,            "#FAEEDA",
    ri < 100,           "#FFF8E1",
    ri < 150,           "#EAF3DE",
    "#C0DD97"
)

measures.name: _CF CatAction BG
measures.expression:
SWITCH([MS Customer Action in Category],
    "Priority Target",      "#FCEBEB",
    "Growth Opportunity",   "#FAEEDA",
    "Capture Remaining",    "#E6F1FB",
    "Protect Position",     "#EAF3DE",
    "Fully Penetrated",     "#EAF3DE",
    BLANK()
)

measures.name: _CF TargetStatus BG
measures.expression:
SWITCH([MS Current vs Target Status],
    "Achieved",             "#C0DD97",
    "Near target",          "#EAF3DE",
    "Halfway",              "#FAEEDA",
    "Below target",         "#FCEBEB",
    BLANK()
)
